title: Genotype and phenotype analyses of 689 individuals with PCDH19-clustering epilepsy
title_zh: 689名PCDH19相关簇集性癫痫个体的基因型与表型分析
abstract: Abstract PCDH19 -clustering epilepsy ( PCDH19- CE) is an infantile-onset neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by clusters of seizures, typically triggered by fever. PCDH19 -CE follows an unusual X-linked inheritance pattern whereby heterozygous females, and males with X-chromosome disomy or pathogenic postzygotic mosaic PCDH19 variants, are affected, while hemizygous males are spared. We aggregate published PCDH19 variants and their corresponding PCDH19 -CE phenotypes to analyse phenotype-genotype correlations. Data extracted from 110 publications identified 689/735 (94%) individuals with PCDH19 variants and the typical PCDH19 -CE phenotype. Three hundred seventy-three unique PCDH19 variants were identified; 195 were not recorded in ClinVar. Seizure onset prior to 12 months of age was associated with more severe intellectual disability (p < 0.001) and the presence of psychiatric morbidity (p = 0.001). There were no phenotypic differences between missense, nonsense, and frameshift variants or between individuals of different geographical backgrounds, which was assessed as a proxy for ancestry. Twenty-nine hemizygous males with constitutive PCDH19 variants did not exhibit the typical PCDH19 -CE phenotype, suggesting that the identification of variants in these individuals likely results from chance or ascertainment bias. The correlation between earlier seizure onset and poorer neurodevelopmental outcomes emphasises a critical window for therapeutic intervention. The lack of phenotypic difference between variant types demonstrates that loss of PCDH19 function underpins PCDH19 -CE. Moreover, the identification of PCDH19 cytoplasmic domain variants in 78 affected individuals challenges the traditional view that PCDH19 -CE is caused primarily by defects in cell-cell adhesion, as variants in this domain are expected to disrupt the nuclear function(s) of PCDH19.
abstract_zh: 摘要：PCDH19相关簇集性癫痫（PCDH19-CE）是一种婴儿期起病的神经发育障碍，以通常由发热诱发的簇集性癫痫发作为特征。PCDH19-CE具有不寻常的X连锁遗传模式：杂合子女性，以及具有X染色体二体或合子后致病性PCDH19嵌合变异的男性会发病，而半合子男性通常不受影响。我们汇总了已发表的PCDH19变异及相应的PCDH19-CE表型，分析表型与基因型之间的相关性。从110篇文献中提取的数据确定了689/735名（94%）携带PCDH19变异且具有典型PCDH19-CE表型的个体。共鉴定出373种不同的PCDH19变异，其中195种尚未收录于ClinVar。12月龄前首次出现癫痫发作与更严重的智力障碍（p<0.001）及精神合并症的存在（p=0.001）相关。错义、无义与移码变异之间，以及不同地理背景的个体之间均无表型差异；研究以地理背景作为遗传祖源的替代指标。29名携带全身性（非嵌合性）PCDH19变异的半合子男性未表现出典型PCDH19-CE表型，提示在这些个体中检出变异可能源于偶然或病例识别偏倚。癫痫发作起病越早、神经发育结局越差的相关性，强调了治疗干预的关键时间窗。不同变异类型之间缺乏表型差异，表明PCDH19功能丧失是PCDH19-CE的基础。此外，在78名受影响个体中发现PCDH19胞质结构域变异，挑战了PCDH19-CE主要由细胞间黏附缺陷引起的传统观点，因为该结构域的变异预计会破坏PCDH19在细胞核内的功能。
